findings.name: ElevenLabsSpeechToSpeech
findings.claim: ElevenLabsSpeechToSpeech keeps words and emotion; knobs are speed/stability, not pitch_rate.
findings.design_implication: this is the Cloud node that transforms the Kokoro file without minting new text.

findings.name: XiaoiceSing
findings.claim: XiaoiceSing residual F0 and DiffSinger MIDI-B condition one model on lyrics+MIDI.
findings.design_implication: score F0 is a residual around one singer, not a new TTS per note.

findings.name: CoMelSinger: Discrete Token-Based Zero-Shot Singing Synthesis With Structured Melody Control and Guidance
findings.claim: Zero-shot SVS with lyric + pitch tokens under MaskGCT; contrastive anti-prosody-leakage hardens score-lock beyond STUDY-011 MIDI+lyrics.
findings.design_implication: Deepen score-lock axis; structured melody control.

findings.name: DiffSinger README
findings.claim: Fork positioned as SVS production tooling (OpenUtau/DiffScope); variance controllability on score-driven synthesis.
findings.design_implication: Community editor lock, not free song gen.

findings.name: SoulX-Singer: Towards High-Quality Zero-Shot Singing Voice Synthesis
findings.claim: Score-control mode takes MIDI + lyrics only; MIDI timing constraints lower WER vs melody-only F0 mode under lyric rewrite.
findings.design_implication: Score-native MIDI+lyrics path; deepen wave-03 score-lock axis.

findings.name: DiTSinger: Scaling Singing Voice Synthesis with Diffusion Transformer and Implicit Alignment
findings.claim: DiT SVS conditioned on pitch, phonemes, word durations, slur; still score-bound (implicit alignment does not drop MIDI).
findings.design_implication: Implicit alignment stays score-bound; not a free song generator.

findings.name: OpenUtau MidiWriter.cs
findings.claim: MIDI import builds UNote from NoteNumber/Time/Length and attaches LyricEvent; pitch×time×lyric co-enforced.
findings.design_implication: Hard MIDI+lyric project objects.

findings.name: YingMusic-Singer: Zero-shot Singing Voice Synthesis and Editing with Annotation-free Melody Guidance
findings.claim: Melody-driven SVS without phoneme-level duration/pitch annotation; soft annotation vs hard MIDI — still not free lyrics-to-song.
findings.design_implication: Soft vs hard melody conditioning on score-lock axis.
findings.authors: Zheng, Hao, Ma, Zhang, Chen, Ding et al.

findings.name: DiffSinger
findings.claim: DiffSinger is score-conditioned SVS (lyrics+pitch+duration → mel); MIDI-B path in official repo; code MIT / OpenVPI Apache 2.0; RTF 0.191.
findings.design_implication: This family can take MIDI as an acoustic condition; render is offline.

findings.name: NNSVS
findings.claim: NNSVS+WORLD hard-locks phone durations to note length; MIT + modified-BSD; real-time RTF; MOS 3.86 vs recordings 4.39.
findings.design_implication: Source-filter SVS is the only local real-time score-locked path with permissive licenses.

findings.name: VISinger 2
findings.claim: Predicted F0 drives a DDSP harmonic oscillator as a hard pitch constraint; official weights not confirmed.
findings.design_implication: Hybrid DSP+neural SVS can keep F0 hard-constrained.
findings.authors: Zhang, Xue, Li, Xie et al.

findings.name: StyleSinger
findings.claim: Notes+lyrics SVS plus reference clip; trained on M4Singer CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; authors will restrict code and models.
findings.design_implication: Published neural-SVS data/weights are not commercial-safe for a public npm tool.

findings.name: ACE-Step 1.5
findings.claim: Lyrics+caption → mixed song; MIT; BPM/key are metadata, not note MIDI.
findings.design_implication: Commercially licensed local song generator, not a singing instrument.

findings.name: DiffRhythm 2
findings.claim: Paper states SVS produces vocals with predefined melodies; song generation does not; Apache 2.0 v2 weights.
findings.design_implication: Cannot honor MIDI; v1 VAE is NC-capped.

findings.name: DiffSinger ConfigurationSchemas
findings.claim: Variance pitch defaults predict_pitch + use_melody_encoder; midi_smooth_width smooths MIDI step→base pitch — MIDI is the prior.
findings.design_implication: MIDI sequence as hard pitch prior.

findings.name: LeVo: High-Quality Song Generation with Multi-Preference Alignment
findings.claim: Lyrics (+ optional text/audio prompts) → mixed song; BPM/structure labels, not note-level MIDI lock.
findings.design_implication: Generator off score-lock ACCEPT lane.

findings.name: SmoothSinger: A Conditional Diffusion Model for Singing Voice Synthesis with Multi-Resolution Architecture
findings.claim: Conditional diffusion SVS from musical scores requiring precise pitch, duration, articulation — score-bound, not mixed-song gen.
findings.design_implication: Score-conditioned diffusion on lock pole.

findings.name: so-vits-svc 4.0
findings.claim: Converts a dry vocal into a cloned singer; F0 comes from the source recording, not MIDI; AGPL-3.0.
findings.design_implication: SVC can retimbre a DSP/MIDI-driven dry vocal; MIDI control stays upstream; AGPL is a ship-blocker for the public package.

findings.name: SongGen: A Single Stage Auto-regressive Transformer for Text-to-Song Generation
findings.claim: Single-stage text-to-song (lyrics + descriptions ± voice clip); no MIDI note hard constraint.
findings.design_implication: Generator without note MIDI lock.

findings.name: TCSinger 2: Customizable Multilingual Zero-shot Singing Voice Synthesis
findings.claim: Multilingual zero-shot SVS dependent on phoneme/note boundary structure; not a lyrics-to-song foundation model.
findings.design_implication: Phoneme/note SVS lane; not generator.
findings.authors: Zhang, Guo, Pan, Yao, Zhu, Jiang et al.

findings.name: SemBridge: Semantic Token Anchoring for Continuous-Latent Autoregressive Speech Generation
findings.claim: Score-conditioned SVS with lyrics plus score-derived pitch and duration under semantic anchoring.
findings.design_implication: Semantic anchoring under explicit musical constraints.
findings.authors: Xie, Lin, Qian, Guo, Jiang, Wang et al.

findings.name: SongEcho: Towards Cover Song Generation via Instance-Adaptive Element-wise Linear Modulation
findings.claim: Cover-song generation synthesizes vocals+accompaniment; contrasts with SVS/SVC single-track score-controlled vocals.
findings.design_implication: Cover pole ≠ MIDI+lyric instrument.
findings.authors: Li, Li, Wang, Zhang, Wu, Deussen et al.

findings.name: MPEcho: A Melody and Phoneme-Aware Generative Framework for Controllable Cover Song Generation
findings.claim: Cover CSG conditioned on melody and phonemes; still ≠ MIDI+lyrics score-lock SVS.
findings.design_implication: Melody/phoneme cover pole off ACCEPT score-lock lane.
findings.authors: Lee, Yeh, Hu, Tan, Tsai & Yang
